all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] Docs (AGENTS, CLAUDE, INSTALL, README, USAGE, commands/status) present `.git/metareview/runs/` as the shared path; in a linked worktree `.git` is a file, so that path does not resolve from the checkout. A reader in a linked worktree looks for runs at a path that does not exist.

[BUG] MigrateLegacyRows copies 0.13.x rows unchanged, so migrated rows keep FSMRunDir `.metareview/runs/<id>/` while RowFor now defines it relative to git's common directory (`metareview/runs/<id>/`). The ledger mixes two path conventions; a consumer resolving FSMRunDir against the common dir gets a wrong path for migrated rows.

[ADVISORY] The bookkeeping test calls LegacyRunsPending on a non-git t.TempDir(), so repo.StoreDir fails and it returns false without inspecting .torn. The assertion cannot fail; the bookkeeping property is untested at the status layer.

[BUG] mine() passes r.workDir straight to repo.Toplevel; if that subdirectory of a linked worktree was deleted, git cannot run there and the run falls to the here==main fallback. A linked worktree loses its abandoned-run blocker (reported only from the main checkout) though the worktree still exists.

[BUG] Discovery scans the shared store before the legacy store; an fsm command that migrates a run between the two scans makes both miss it. status can omit an abandoned-run blocker while a migration is in progress.

[BUG] mine() runs repo.Toplevel on the nearest existing ancestor of a run's work_dir without checking that the toplevel belongs to this repository (same git common dir); for a removed linked worktree whose parent lies inside an unrelated git repo, Toplevel returns that repo and the here==main fallback is never reached. The abandoned run is attributed to a foreign toplevel matching no worktree of this repo and disappears from every checkout's status and Stop gate.

findings.issue_text: [ADVISORY] Each abandoned run costs two uncached git subprocesses (StoreDir then Toplevel), not memoized per ancestor dir although many runs share a work_dir. Status and Stop-hook latency grows as about 2 x abandoned runs across all worktrees (the store is shared); seconds once stale runs reach the low hundreds.
